about: Shared style limits for scientific prose. sci-prose-style/scripts/prose_lint.py and the manuscript kit's check_manuscript.py both read this file, and the two copies must stay identical (tools/validate_skills.py checks this). Patterns are case-insensitive Python regular expressions. Caps count matches in running text; they apply unchanged up to reference_words and scale in proportion above it. Banned patterns are reported at every match; advisory counts are hints that need a human decision. source 'user' marks the author's own rules; 'kit' marks house defaults. A project changes an entry in manuscript.json under style.overrides, keyed by label: a number sets a cap, null switches the entry off, for example {"boundary": 5, "state-of-the-art": null}.

caps.label: must
caps.fix: keep for physical or logical necessity; advice to the field reads better as "needs" or "should"

caps.label: therefore
caps.fix: keep for a real inference; otherwise order the sentences so no connector is needed

caps.label: thus/hence
caps.fix: same budget as therefore, so the cap cannot be met by swapping words

caps.label: contrast (rather than, X, not Y)
caps.fix: keep for contrasts that are the finding; otherwise state the positive claim

caps.label: boundary
caps.fix: name the accounting scope once (the unit a value is counted over), then use that word

caps.label: dash aside
caps.fix: fold the aside into the sentence, use a comma pair or brackets, or cut it

banned.label: useful
banned.fix: say what it allows: "sets the read margin"

banned.label: credible
banned.fix: give the evidence level and the condition

banned.label: This is why
banned.fix: join cause and effect in one sentence with "because" or "so"

banned.label: notably
banned.fix: delete; the content carries the weight

banned.label: landscape
banned.fix: name the field or the set of works

banned.label: furthermore
banned.fix: delete; order sentences from known to new

banned.label: evaluative triplet
banned.fix: keep only the property you then support with a number; lists of measured quantities are fine

banned.label: colon reveal
banned.fix: state the claim as the sentence

banned.label: it is worth noting
banned.pattern: \bit is worth (?:noting|mentioning|emphasi[sz]ing)\b|\bit should be noted that\b

banned.label: paradigm shift
banned.fix: say what changes and by how much

banned.label: cutting-edge
banned.fix: the best reported value with its conditions

banned.label: state-of-the-art
banned.fix: name the reference: "the best reported value, X (conditions) [ref]"

banned.label: vast potential
banned.fix: the measured gain and its condition

banned.label: superb, impactful, meticulous
banned.fix: the metric and value, or delete

banned.label: shaping the future
banned.fix: what changes and by how much

banned.label: continues to evolve
banned.fix: what changed, with dates or numbers

banned.label: screening-report voice
banned.fix: narrate the field's progress (problem, idea, realisation, result); the search protocol belongs in Methods or the cover letter

banned.label: in a preprint
banned.fix: cite directly; the reference list shows preprint status

banned.label: per-paper fault-finding
banned.pattern: \bet al\.?(?:\s*\[[^\]]*\])? (?:did not|do not|does not|failed to|neglected to|omitted to) (?:state|report|give|specify|mention|measure|disclose)\b
banned.fix: state the gap at field level with citations ("X is rarely reported with Y [@a; @b]"); a table may mark n.s.

advisory.label: colon before a lowercase clause
advisory.fix: lists after a colon are fine; a colon that reveals a claim is banned, so check each one

advisory.label: defensive phrase
advisory.pattern: \bso far\b|\bto date\b|\bnot yet\b|\b(?:has|have) not (?:yet )?been\b|\bremains? (?:missing|unclear|unknown|unexplored|limited|lacking|to be (?:shown|demonstrated|seen))\b|\bcannot yet\b|\bstill (?:lacks?|needs?|requires?|missing|limited)\b
advisory.fix: state what was done, then the next experiment or design implication ("the next demonstration would…"); keep evidence labels next to the number

advisory.label: only (limiting)
advisory.fix: give the number without the apology ("three samples", not "only three samples") unless the limit is the point

banned_openers.label: In summary opener
banned_openers.fix: end the section on its consequence; no summary signpost

manual: coined jargon (user rule): every technical term appears in the cited literature or the terminology table
one idea per sentence; no stacked clauses and no fragments
paragraph order: topic sentence, quantitative evidence with conditions, one-sentence implication
review voice (user rule): reviews narrate the field's progress through key works; no screening, counting or grading of papers
flow (user rule): link each sentence to the previous one by a connective or a shared subject; prose_lint reports staccato runs and orphan paragraphs
quantifiers (user rule): keep the source's about, up to, estimated, total; never add motives or mechanisms the source lacks; check every derived magnitude arithmetically
